name: Apex Solventless Live Rosin Thumbprint | Bluebs & Limes
description: Blueberry Zyrup cold cure + Sudachi jam makes this thumbprint a pure delight. Terpenes give cannabis its distinct smell and flavor. They also work with cannabinoids to create the plant's various effects and benefits. The most abundant terpene inthis Apex - 2g Rosin Thumbprint - Bluebs & Limes is Limonene, followed by Beta Caryophyllene and Beta Myrcene.
